name: handoff
description: Handoff on request: warns when context is nearly full, points to /handoff when you ask for a handoff, and provides /handoff

auto_handoff._doc: Context-usage warning at Stop. When the wrap-up gate blocks and context usage is at or above token_warn_ratio, one line is appended suggesting /handoff (once per session). Nothing is written for the next session; a handoff note is only written when someone runs /handoff. enabled=false or token_warn=false turns the warning off. Token measurement reads the real token counts from the transcript's message.usage; context_window_tokens is the default / floor of the denominator (1M, matching the usual 1M Opus), and the actual window calibrates itself: once usage has gone past 200k the window must be 1M (the harness compacts before a 200k window fills up, so 200k is never reached). context_base_overhead_tokens is only used by the character-count fallback (when there is no usage). The core's DeferralGate and EVASION_CONTEXT_EXEMPT also read context_window_tokens / context_base_overhead_tokens from this section, with the same literal defaults when the plugin is off.
